mapper.insert: INSERT INTO parking_record (record_no, parking_lot_id, parking_space_id, fee_rule_id, vehicle_id, license_plate, entry_admin_id, entry_time, status) VALUES (#{recordNo}, #{parkingLotId}, #{parkingSpaceId}, #{feeRuleId}, #{vehicleId}, #{licensePlate}, #{entryAdminId}, #{entryTime}, 'PARKING')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM parking_record WHERE license_plate = #{licensePlate} AND status = 'PARKING'
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parking_record WHERE record_no = #{recordNo})
